cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-restores-and-releases
cases.purpose: Repeated start and stop restore windows and release timers, input interception, tracking and buffers without starting processes.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-key-wakes-without-editing
cases.purpose: A wake key restores the original buffer without editing it.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-pointer-wakes
cases.purpose: Mouse movement, a complete click and wheel input dismiss the presentation.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-mode-is-idempotent
cases.purpose: Automatic mode owns one idle watcher and disabling it releases both watcher and presentation.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-program-order-and-options
cases.purpose: Nested groups preserve sequence boundaries and scene options merge with item settings.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-shuffle-and-random
cases.purpose: Shuffle covers each bag once; random selection honors its count and seeded playback is repeatable.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-timed-cycle
cases.purpose: Actual timer-driven playback advances scenes and repeats the configured program.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-unicode-and-seeded-particles
cases.purpose: Canvas-only output preserves mixed Unicode text, color and repeatable particle initialization.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-bundled-scenes-run
cases.purpose: Every bundled scene renders and advances autonomously without workspace controls.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-banner-rotates-effects
cases.purpose: A long-running banner rotates its effect and colour without failing.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-invalid-start-rolls-back
cases.purpose: Bad configuration and scene failures leave the editor and resource inventory unchanged.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-external-buffer-kill-cleans-up
cases.purpose: Externally killing the presentation buffer restores windows and cancels animation.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-tests-loader-and-catalog
cases.purpose: Scene files replace registrations while a malformed file reports independently.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-playback-follows-recording
cases.purpose: A registered reel plays frames in recording order, honors provider metadata and loops.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-wide-ansi-frames-keep-colors
cases.purpose: ANSI recordings with wide characters publish centered colored canvas rows.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-imports-a-recording
cases.purpose: Importing a Terminal Text Effects recording copies it, writes a reel spec and the reel plays.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-batch-report-classifies-files
cases.purpose: Batch import reports compatible, unrecognized and invalid recordings separately.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-rejects-invalid-recordings
cases.purpose: Wrong versions, truncated streams and invalid frames signal errors and write nothing.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-loader-skips-broken-reels
cases.purpose: A reel spec with a missing recording is reported and skipped without disturbing other scenes.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-image-frames-advance
cases.purpose: Baked image frames publish display slices that advance in order.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-imports-frame-bundle
cases.purpose: Importing a frame bundle copies every file, writes the reel spec and plays it.

cases.name: etaf-screensaver-reel-tests-rejects-broken-frame-bundles
cases.purpose: Missing frames, non-images and bad JSON signal and write nothing.
